disposition_inventory.canonicalization: document-order TSV of level-2 section plus every table data row's item, disposition, and rationale cells, with Markdown code ticks removed and LF terminator

capability_inventory.canonicalization: lexicographically sorted first cell of every table row whose scope is In, with LF terminator

operation_inventory.canonicalization: lexicographically sorted exact operation IDs from the canonical operation tables, with LF terminator

closure.upstream_to_disposition: Every pinned upstream item has one exact source-path/item ID and one exact disposition row ID.
closure.disposition_to_capability: Every row is explicitly classified; in-scope rows name exact canonical capability IDs and non-capability/client/deployment/product/security rows name none unless they also retain an in-scope backend capability.
closure.capability_to_operation: Every referenced canonical capability names its frozen exact operation-ID set; no owner-based lower bound or inferred operation is accepted.
closure.operation_to_owner_goal: Each exact operation resolves through its API_OPERATIONS.md owner list and the frozen owner_goal_closure (or a registered existing primitive) to an implementation goal.

item_closure.canonicalization: rows in disposition order as upstream_item_id, source_locator, source_kind, source_object_id, disposition_row_id, classification, sorted capability IDs, and sorted exact operation IDs; then lexicographically sorted capability-to-operation, operation-to-owner, and owner-to-goal edges; tab-separated with LF terminator
